description: Reusable automation setups. action list: your templates and Hermoso's (stop_losers, scale_winners and others). get: one, with its inputs. create: name, description and either automations ([{engine: meta_rule | google_rule | tiktok_rule | boost, body: what its create tool takes}], up to 20) or from ({automationIds: [ids from list_automations]}, {templateId: a Hermoso template} or {shareToken}); the ad account each one runs on becomes an input, and campaign or ad ids are dropped. update: the same fields on templateId. share / unshare: a link token anyone can read and install from. delete (confirm:true). install: templateId plus inputs ({account_1: '<ad account id>', ...}) into THIS brand. shared + install_shared: read or install another team's shared template by shareToken. Every installed automation is created OFF. Free.

confirm.description: delete: true after the user agreed

share.description: create/update: also make a share link

templateId.description: a template id (tpl_… or a Hermoso template id)
